Comment: FileNotesOrchestration — the Step Functions version of the upload/note atomicity fix from the Orchestrating Services lab. Input: {"fileKey": ..., "note": ..., "bucketName": ...}. The S3 upload itself already happened in S3UploadFunction before this execution starts (a Step Functions execution input is capped at 256 KB, and isn't a natural place to carry binary file bytes) — this state machine's whole job is the DynamoDB write, its retries, and a compensating S3 delete if every retry fails. EDIT ME: fill in <YOUR_TABLE_NAME> (should be FileNotes, matching every other function in this app) before deploying.

SaveFailed.Cause: DynamoDB PutItem failed after retries; the uploaded S3 object was deleted as a compensating action.

SaveFailedCompensationAlsoFailed.Cause: DynamoDB PutItem failed after retries, AND the compensating S3 delete also failed — the uploaded file is now orphaned with no note. This is the exact gap a state machine cannot fully close on its own either; the difference from the hand-rolled version is that this failure is now a clean, named terminal state visible in the execution history, not just an error message in a response body.
